profile.headline: Senior Solution Architect
profile.summary: I organize very small magnetic fields and sentient bilateral mammalian resources.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Architect
positions.description:
• Project lead for tax software solution for energy company. Wrote code, managed resources, and sold additional SOWs. Oversaw team resourcing and SOW adherence, managing developer hours and deliverables to avoid scope creep while ensuring full use of the client’s budget.

• Led integration efforts for an SAP conversion; partnering with stakeholders on requirements gathering, estimation,  successfully shaping and selling the SOW, and finally guided development team through implementation and delivery.

• Served as lead developer on a big data modernization project in the banking industry; developed large-scale data queries, back-end business logic, and front-end architecture. Collaborated with internal security teams to ensure PCI compliance, and actively mentored junior developers through ongoing one-on-one feedback and support. (C#, .NET, SQL Server, Trino, React)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Directed a lean development team in building a custom CMS that enabled the client teams to deploy tailored sales sites and engagement dashboards, integrating with internal data sources and managing user permissions. (C#, .NET, Angular)

• Architected a dynamic front-end editing experience using Angular, including live in-browser editing, micro front ends, and a microservice-based backend. (C#, .NET, Angular)

• Owned sprint planning, code reviews, and stakeholder communication, ensuring alignment between technical implementation and evolving client needs in a hybrid client-vendor environment.

• Mentored and coached developers, resulting in multiple team member promotions; conducted performance reviews and made personnel decisions to maintain team effectiveness.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Led a team to build a custom content management system & in-browser editor that would accelerate the client's ability create integrated, consistent, and customizable proposals & websites for their clients. (C#, .net core, Angular)

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
•	Dev lead for several microservice development teams
•	Designed and implemented multiple microservice APIs using C# and .Net Core
•	Built multiple front-ends using Angular & Vue
•	Architected and built integrations with payment processing gateway and Kafka
•	Built test suite to automate payment processor validation
•	Taught technical training sessions for colleagues
•	Participated as a mentor for multiple newer teammates

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
• As a solo founder I built a DIY Lawn Care app & social network
• Architected scalable cloud-first back-end in Azure
• Used Azure SQL & C# functions as source-of-truth and business logic
• Built scalable user data storage using Azure Storage
• Setup CI/CD using Azure DevOps pipelines
• I built both iOS & Android apps using Flutter platform
• Used Firebase for auth service & push notifications
• Setup and integrated Google AdMob for app revenue

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
* Worked on team to build a project management software package for a company in the energy industry.
* Built complex MVVM web pages using KnockoutJs
* Acted as the JavaScript domain expert for structuring and building web pages
* Built API services and business logic using Java 8, Spring Boot, and Hibernate
* Architected and built caching solution for both server-side and client-side caching

positions.title: Consultant II
positions.description:
* Development team lead for Xamarin iOS mobile application.
* Architected for API backend for mobile project using Java Spring Boot.
* Designed and built Oracle database for mobile project
* Performed Business Analyst role for Agile project, working with subject matter experts to gather business requirements, writing user stories, and created functional specifications.

* Helped build an ASP.Net MVC 5 WebAPI order management system for an industry leading client. 
* Improved application performance by moving code from Entity Framework to T-SQL Stored Procedure.
* Implemented MVVM front-end using knockout.js, jQuery, and Bootstrap.
* Created tabular data user interface by interfacing knockout.js and DataTables.
* Designed and implemented a caching framework using AppCache to improve application performance.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Migrated all websites to new server and into a new CMS. Resulted in a department savings of $90,000/year in maintenance contracts and server costs.
* Built a New Student Orientation check-in system allowing the students to check-in via web application or by text message. This cut time required for students to check-in by half.
* Built web application to organize and manage New Student Orientation events and activities.
* Developed custom backup software for all Undergraduate Education websites.
* Deployed and managed monitoring software for departmental technology.
* Migrated departmental file server from Samba to Windows File Server.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer in Test Intern
positions.description:
* Automated UI tests using Coded UI for customer facing Microsoft Events application.
* Audited security for and built a security testing suite for Microsoft Events.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Developed virtual valve simulator for testing future model tractors.
* Developed automated testing software to program controllers and subsequently test values from programming.

positions.title: Linux System Administrator/Web Developer
positions.description:
* Linux server administration (Apache, MySQL, Unix permissions, User administration)
* Drupal deployment, theming, programming, and migration
* Wiki and CMS deployment

positions.title: Jr. System Administrator
positions.description:
* Desktop support (MS Office, Outlook, Zimbra, Oaisys, OS Installation)
* Telephony support (Telephone database management, call configuration and routing)
* Linux Server support (SFTP, Nagios, SVN)
* Networking support (Cabling, Cisco switch configuration

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: QA for various web applications including classifieds software, and data mining software.

positions.title: Network Analyst
positions.description:
* Monitoring and first level support for BYU and LDS Church servers
* Primary support for BYU network issues
* Achieved second level certification in Windows Server 2003, Linux, Netware, and Cisco Routers

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · May 2003

projects.title: Where Can I Watch My Team
projects.description:
A website to identify ideal streaming services based on sports team.

Built with Vue.js, vuex, Express, and Postgres.

projects.title: Server Migration
projects.description: When one of our SAS controllers died it was time for a change. We decided to move all of our resources to a personal VMware cloud. To this point we have moved one of our main servers, and several smaller applications. We plan to have the rest of our resources moved over by December 2013.
